mxCell.value: Page 1: High Functional Big Data & AI Architecture — Peta Digital UMKM Surabaya Timur
DATA SOURCES 1. Google Maps Places API (6 Kecamatan) 2. Survei Lapangan SWK (43 sample/keep) 3. Kaggle Dataset & Dokumen Regulasi PDF
ETL & PYSPARK STAGING - Filter sample/keep vs sample/reject (627 ditolak) - PySpark SQL Multimodal Join (pyspark_staging.py) - Data Schema Catalog
DATA OCEAN / GOOGLE DRIVE STORAGE - G:\My Drive\Images-GMAPS (203 Foto Bersih) - G:\My Drive\Text Numeric-GMAPS (256 UMKM, 1.017 Ulasan) - data/staging_spark/umkm_spark_staged.parquet

DATA TRANSFORMATION & FEATURE STORE - Processing: Regex PII, OpenCV Face Blur (321 wajah) - EDA: model/eda/eda_analysis.py - Feature & Embedding: TF-IDF (32) + StandardScaler + PCA (6) - Output: embeddings_multimodal.npy | .npz | .parquet

ANALYTICS OPERATING SYSTEM & MODEL REGISTRY (model/saved/) - Machine Learning (.pkl): K-Means, Random Forest Clf, XGBoost Clf, RF Regressor, Ridge - Deep Learning (.pt/.pth/.h5): DeepAutoencoder, PyTorch MLP Clf, PyTorch MLP Reg, YOLOv8 - Evaluation (model/evaluation/model_evaluation.py): GroupKFold, Silhouette, Cohen's Kappa, RMSE/R2, SHAP

SPATIAL BDA, INFERENCING & AI APPLICATION (app/) - Spatial BDA (model/analytics/bda_analytics.py): Digital Gap Index 6 Kecamatan Surabaya Timur - FastAPI Server (app/server/main.py) & Streamlit Client (app/client/dashboard.py)
Page 2: Flowchart of Method Based on Big Data Architecture (Unsupervised & Supervised Loop)
1. Data Importing & Filter sample/keep (256 UMKM, 1.017 Ulasan, 203 Foto Clean, 627 Reject)
2. PySpark Staging & Google Drive Sync (Images-GMAPS & Text Numeric-GMAPS)
3. Data Analyzing (EDA) & Data Splitting (Jalur A: Clustering | Jalur B: Supervised)

Jalur A (Unsupervised Clustering): - ML: K-Means (K=3) - DL: DeepClusteringAutoencoder + Latent KMeans - Gate: Optimal Cluster? (Silhouette Score) - Simpan: ml_clustering_kmeans.pkl & dl_clustering_autoencoder.pt/.pth/.h5

Jalur B (Supervised Classification & Regression): - Feature Extraction & Embedding (.npy, .npz, .parquet) - ML Classification (RF, XGBoost) & ML Regression (RF Reg, Ridge) - DL Classification (MLP, YOLOv8) & DL Regression (MLP Regressor) - Gate: GroupKFold Accuracy/F1 > 70% & R2 > 0.85? (Capai F1=95.6%, R2=0.98) - Simpan: .pkl & .pt/.pth/.h5 di model/saved/
Page 3: Application Architecture Based on AI using C4 Model (app/client, app/server, model/)
Container 1: app/client/ (Streamlit Web Client) - dashboard.py (4 Tab Analitik BDA, Simulasi 6 Model, Direktori, Artefak) - api_client.py (BackendClient REST HTTP + Fallback)

Container 2: app/server/ (FastAPI Inference Server) - main.py (/health, /bda/summary, /umkm/list, /predict/multimodal) - inference_service.py (UMKMInferenceService) - schemas.py (Pydantic Request/Response)

Container 3: model/saved/ (Stored Models & Embeddings) - ML (.pkl): ml_clustering_kmeans, ml_classification_rf/xgb, ml_regression_rf/ridge - DL (.pt/.pth/.h5): dl_clustering_autoencoder, dl_classification_mlp, dl_regression_mlp, yolov8 - Embeddings: embeddings_multimodal.npy | .npz | .parquet
Page 4: Flowchart of Application Based on Artificial Intelligence (Client-Server Inference Flow)
1. User Membuka Dashboard Streamlit (app/client/dashboard.py)
2. Input Profil & Indikator UMKM (Rating, Ulasan, QRIS, Ojol, POS, EDC)
3. HTTP POST /predict/multimodal ke FastAPI Server (app/server/main.py)

4. Eksekusi Serentak 6 Model di UMKMInferenceService: - ML Clustering (.pkl), ML Classification (.pkl), ML Regression (.pkl) - DL Clustering (.pt/.h5), DL Classification (.pt/.h5), DL Regression (.pt/.h5) + Pencocokan Rekomendasi Intervensi & Tabel BDA Kecamatan
